item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem:
Meera's grandmother cooks dal on a clay chulha using firewood, while Meera's mother cooks the same dal in a pressure cooker on a gas stove. Which of the following statements about traditional and modern cooking practices is incorrect ( )
A. Cooking practices have changed over time, so traditional and modern methods can differ
B. Modern cooking practices, like using a pressure cooker, can save time and fuel compared to older methods
C. Traditional and modern cooking practices differ only because different people like different tastes
D. Traditional cooking methods, like using a chulha, were suited to the tools and fuels available in earlier times

options.A: Cooking practices have changed over time, so traditional and modern methods can differ
options.B: Modern cooking practices, like using a pressure cooker, can save time and fuel compared to older methods
options.C: Traditional and modern cooking practices differ only because different people like different tastes
options.D: Traditional cooking methods, like using a chulha, were suited to the tools and fuels available in earlier times
